(2) NEW E2E test seeds a completed outbound_coach session in Mongo, POSTs /api/ai-coach/sessions/{id}/generate-followup-email → 200 with subject_en/subject_fr/body/count=1/max=3, then POSTs /api/twilio/contractor/emails/send with call_log_id → 200, then Mongo verification confirms ai_voice_calls.followup_emails_generated[$].sent==True + sent_at set + email_row_id back-reference to the new contractor_emails row. (7) Regression smoke: /contractor/emails without prefill renders composer with NO banner + NO badges. Homepage loads without page errors. (8) Ran the FULL related backend suite (iter321/324/332/334/335/336) — 53/53 tests pass, zero regressions on twilio, coach WS, IVR.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED a real deep-link routing bug in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.js: the SECONDARY_TO_PRIMARY map in the mount effect was missing entries for the tabs under primary='team' (ai-coach-sessions, ai-voice-calls, careers, press-blogs, team-members). Without this, a URL like /admin?tab=ai-coach-sessions would set secondaryTab correctly but leave primaryTab='marketplace', which then triggered the [primaryTab] effect to reset secondaryTab back to a marketplace default. This broke the iter336 Regenerate flow from Email Hub → Coach Sessions until fixed. Added mappings and verified via UI E2E — regenerate link now correctly returns user to the coach sessions tab with auto-expand.
iter336 backend rate-limit envelope is bilingual (message_en + message_fr) — matches spec exactly.

The linkage design between contractor_emails and ai_voice_calls is ONE-WAY: contractor_emails does NOT store call_log_id. Instead ai_voice_calls.followup_emails_generated[$].email_row_id back-references the contractor_emails.id. This is by design and cleanly separates PII from the coach-session audit trail. UI 'Sent' badge on the FollowUpEmailPanel is driven by the followup_emails_generated[$].sent flag — correct.
AI banner + badge disappearance logic in ContractorEmailHub.jsx uses strict equality (subject === prefill.subject) — a single keystroke breaks equality and hides the badge, exactly as spec'd.
